items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And when you play like the Hindemith Sonata is a perfect example of that.

ctx.x: They taught them how to rehearse.

You see what I mean? And then of course half the orchestra knows [scats] and the conductor doesn’t, they don’t even watch them because it’s destroying the music for them. He’s going [scats]. He’s putting the agogic so that you’re hearing every downbeat and it’s not [scats] if you were going to conduct it, but they don’t. You don’t have to conduct it. You have to trust the musicians to make that happen. And if they don’t do that that’s when you tell them, it isn’t [scats], it’s [scats]. And also they go [scats]…
